earth_engine_export.temporary_asset_policy: Delete all chunk assets after the coordinate-free local table is validated and downloaded.

claim_boundary: A subsequent oil-palm class does not show that the fire was deliberately set to create a plantation.
The analysis cannot identify an individual, company, concession holder, or beneficiary.
The analysis cannot measure government mitigation, enforcement, restoration, or negligence without dated intervention data.
Kalimantan results do not establish a global pattern; Phase 5 requires harmonized replication.
